analysis.title: 从模型竞速走向产品、算力与生态：本期 AI 趋势观察
analysis.lead: 本期共整理 131 条有效信号。下面不是新闻复述，而是把论文、公司、创业与政策放在同一张图里后的编辑性判断。
paragraphs: 研究侧共收录 20 条信号，重点包括 《BACE: LLM-based Code Generation through Bayesian Anchored…》、《Reward Hacking Benchmark: Measuring Exploits in LLM Agents…》。与只看榜单相比，更值得持续观察的是论文能否把 Agent 的可靠性、评测完整性与推理成本一起向前推进。
AI 跨领域贡献收录 16 条，代表性事件包括 《Claude Fable 5 协助找到雅可比猜想的显式三维反例》、《OpenAI 模型推翻平面单位距离问题中的长期猜想》。这类结果会区分官方论文、可核验反例、媒体报道与尚待同行评审的社交平台首发，避免把‘可计算验证’和‘完成学术确认’混为一谈。
中国 AI 板块本期收录 16 条动态，已覆盖 Kimi / 月之暗面、DeepSeek、字节豆包 / Seed。代表性变化包括 《月之暗面 发布 Kimi K3.1 Pro》、《狐讯 | 月之暗面 发布 最强模型 Kimi K3.1 Pro;全球首个 Wi-Fi 8 Mesh 系统》；竞争正在从单次模型发布延伸到开源策略、Agent 产品入口、国产算力适配和价格体系。
产业侧共有 30 条前沿实验室与大厂动态、14 条关键人物公开信号，另有 14 条创业和 9 条政策安全更新。模型能力、算力供给、创始人判断、产品分发与合规成本正在变成同一个竞争问题。

takeaways.body: 优先关注带公开证明、实验或可复核数据的 AI 科研贡献，并持续更新同行验证状态。

items.title: Solving a 31-year-old grand challenge in mathematics – the KLS conjecture - Microsoft Research
items.summary: For decades, a fundamental question about the difficulty of computing in high-dimensional spaces has resisted proof. New research resolves this question, removing a major theoretical obstacle to understanding the efficiency of randomized algorithms used across science and computing. The Kannan–Lovász–Simonovits (KLS) conjecture was proposed in 1995. It asks whether, for a broad class of high-dimensional […] The post Solving a 31-year-old grand challenge in mathematics – the KLS conjecture appeared first on Microsoft Research .

items.title: Magnetar brings faster, simpler, quantum-ready zero-knowledge proofs
items.summary: Zero-knowledge proofs can verify computing results without rerunning workloads or exposing sensitive data. Magnetar helps bring them into the mainstream with support for standard programming languages, major speed gains, and quantum-resistant security. The post Proof-based general-purpose computing with Magnetar appeared first on Microsoft Research .

items.title: Simulating student learning for better AI tutoring
items.summary: StudentSim is a research system for evaluating and improving AI tutoring tools before they are tested with learners. It models how individuals may engage with tutors, giving feedback to improve tutor performance across subjects like chess, writing, and mathematics. The post Simulating student learning for better AI tutoring appeared first on Microsoft Research .

items.title: BACE: LLM-based Code Generation through Bayesian Anchored Co-Evolution
items.summary: BACE treats generated code and tests as co-evolving populations instead of accepting synthetic tests as ground truth. Bayesian belief updates model tests as noisy sensors, while public examples anchor the search and reduce self-validating drift. The authors report strong results on LiveCodeBench v6 across proprietary and open-weight models.

items.summary: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) reuses a wireless waveform for data delivery and environmental perception, but this coupling exposes communication payloads, sensing semantics, and downstream inference to a common attacker.
